rst_mngr_api.h

Pulse reset on UART0 or SDMMC, and read whether that block is held in reset.  Any other rst_device_t value returns -EINVAL. The pulse is assert, a short delay, then deassert. The delay length depends on the device.

Types
rst_device_t

Peripherals this API can reset.

Values
RST_DEV_UART0

UART 0.

RST_DEV_SDMMC

SD/MMC controller.

RST_DEV_MAX

Count of named devices. Not a valid target.

reset_device
int32_t reset_device(
rst_device_t 
dev
)

Assert reset, wait, then deassert it.

Parameters
dev
rst_device_t

RST_DEV_UART0 or RST_DEV_SDMMC.

Returns

0 on success. -EINVAL for any other dev. Otherwise the reset-manager status from assert or deassert.

reset_get_device_status
int32_t reset_get_device_status(
rst_device_t 
dev,
uint8_t 
*
status
)

Report whether dev is currently held in reset.

Parameters
dev
rst_device_t

RST_DEV_UART0 or RST_DEV_SDMMC.

status
uint8_t*

Receives the reset-manager status byte. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -EINVAL for an unknown dev or a NULL status pointer. Otherwise the reset-manager status.
